case: Schema-qualified enum update and filter under a quoted shadow search_path
contract: Target and shadow schemas each define a type with spaces and embedded double quotes and the same type name; the shadow enum omits the target-only paused label.
Every pooled connection inherits the shadow schema from the test role's default search_path, while the test fetches metadata for the target table.

Generated keyed update and structured equality filter accept paused by resolving the target enum; native pg_typeof and regtype OID equality identify the target type, and target siblings plus the shadow row remain unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_quoted_identifiers_support_keyed_edit_and_filter -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Additional transaction-local, session-local and role/search_path permutations remain open; this case does not close PostgreSQL enum configuration coverage or B3.
